referents.why: 'Him' is the object of 'questioned' in cl0: Pilate questions Jesus.
'how many things' is the object of 'testify against': the charges. The candidates are people (Jesus, Pilate, the composite c8). No candidate is a charge, so none fits.
referents.category: object that is a thing, not a person

referents.why: 'You' inside Pilate's speech is the addressee of that speech: Jesus.
The implied 'you' of 'Not answer You nothing' is second person singular inside Pilate's speech, so it is the addressee: Jesus.
referents.category: implied second person inside a speech

referents.why: The third plural 'they' are the accusers who bring the charges. The chief priests of Mrk.15.1 are not in the candidate list; the composite c8, the Council bodies named in Mrk.15.1, is the nearest plural accuser listed.

links.why: cl3 is a second sentence of the speech ('Look how many charges...'), not nested in 'Have you no answer?'. Both belong to the speech through content links.
links.category: sentence wrongly nested in a sentence

links.why: The speech is the object of the participle 'saying', nested in it.
links.category: speech nested in participle of saying

links.why: The participle 'saying' is nested in the main clause and describes how he questioned.
A clause cannot be the next event after itself, and no later narrative event follows in this verse.
The opening de joins this to the chief priests' accusing in the verse before. Across verses the then type is not used; the separate connective is and, with the full id.
'saying' introduces what Pilate said: 'Have you no answer?'. Speech-content ruling R1.
'saying' also introduces the second sentence of the same speech.

groups.why: The builder's frame was cl0, the main verb, and its part was cl1, the participle 'saying' itself. The clause that introduces the speech is cl1, and what is said is cl2 and cl3, so the frame moves to cl1 and the parts are the two sentences. cl0 stays outside the turn. Sender is Pilate (w2); addressee is Jesus, so the group is divine.

none_fit.what: Repetition of Pilate's earlier questioning (Mrk.15.2#cl0). No link type marks 'again'.
An exclamation of notice ('look'), not a command to anyone; no group kind for a bare exclamation.

cant_tell.what: Who 'they' in cl3 are: the accusers of Mrk.15.3, who are not in the candidate list.
cant_tell.why: The chief priests are named in Mrk.15.1 but are not offered as a candidate here, and c8 is the only plural accuser listed. Chose c8 for now.
